_about: TRAINING CENTRE settings (19.10.2026). The lists the Training Centre screens and the Excel import read. Statuses and areas are checked in code, never by a database CHECK, so a list can be renamed here without a migration. The defaults marked provisional are the owner's to confirm (MVP interview 19.10.2026: 'rest of questions I'll answer later').

defaults._provisional: The owner's answers are still open (19.10.2026); these are the build's defaults until then.
defaults.multiCountryCompany: one company; an explicit office tag such as /CY/ stays a company of its own
defaults.courseCounts: typed by Training Centre staff; the Excel history is imported

clienthubImport._about: The ONE import of Client Hub contacts (20.10.2026, src/tcclienthub.js). Intake is the master for contacts; Client Hub keeps running the Grand Opening. The links come from TC-DATA's 19.10 cross-check (_training-centre/tools/clienthub_import_extract.mjs).
clienthubImport._tie: The owner, 20.10.2026: a contact whose company fits two or more Excel companies equally goes to the one in the same country, then the one with the closest name; still equal = the review list. tieNeedsSameCountry true = only a same-country candidate may win.
clienthubImport._noCompany: The owner, 20.10.2026: a contact with no company goes on the review list, to be placed by hand.

noMailing._about: The owner, 20.10.2026: imported, marked no mailing in the contact's note (the company page shows it under the email).
noMailing.note: No mailing (Client Hub: unsubscribed or the address bounced)
